summary: Cuprina Holdings (Cayman) Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine underwritten follow-on public offering of 4,322,489 Class A ordinary shares at $1.15 per share, grossing approximately $4.97 million before discounts and expenses. The company entered an underwriting agreement dated September 15, 2026 with R.F. Lafferty Co., Inc. as representative; the F-1 (File No. 333-297299) was declared effective that day. Closing occurred September 17, 2026. The company also issued representative warrants for 172,900 shares at a $1.265 exercise price. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation.
